thread:
sam_partners: Quick ask from Nimbus partner: can we deliver a 30min "mini-quickstart" that creates a tiny reference arch + Terraform module and shows the GH Actions validation flow? They want something forkable.

neil_eng: yes. keep it tiny: module/runtime (vpc optional), storage bucket with KMS, and an endpoint output. demo plan: terraform apply in local sandbox, then a smoke curl to the health endpoint.

olga_docs: I'll prepare a one-page README with steps, example variables.tf, and a 'submit to marketplace' checklist. will include a "mapping to partner VPC" example.

tara_infra: I'll own CI and baseline policies. plan PR -> terraform fmt -> terrascan -> init/plan. optional smoke job gated by partner sandbox creds.

partner_eng: on our side we prefer modules to be opinionated for easier onboarding (defaults for tags, kms, and minimal IAM). also a short note on how to vendor modules into private registries.

neil_eng: agree. add an appendix for hardware tuning (batch, precision) but exclude from core lab. keep module hardware-agnostic.

ci-bot: Action created: partners/mini-validate (automated).

olga_docs: small CI snippet I'll add to the README for partners:
```yaml
name: validate-module
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Terrascan
        run: terrascan scan -d . -p policies/
      - name: Terraform Init & Plan
        run: terraform init -input=false && terraform plan -input=false
```

sam_partners: timeline: workshop Fri 2pm PT, deliverables Wed EOD: repo skeleton under redwood-partners/mini-quickstart, sample module, CI workflow, README. partners to RSVP by Thu.

tara_infra: action items: repo skeleton + GH Actions (tara), terrascan baselines (tara), README (olga), sample module (neil). reconvene Thu 9am to sanity-check. :thumbsup:
